data: Metal-rich M-type asteroid suspected to be the exposed iron–nickel core of an early planetesimal whose mantle was stripped by giant impacts. NASA's Psyche mission launched in October 2023 and arrives in 2029 to map composition and magnetic remanence — the first dedicated visit to a metallic body.
Psyche — NASA, launch 2023 · arrival 2029 (first orbital survey of a metallic M-type asteroid)
16 Psyche may be the exposed nickel-iron core of a protoplanet that lost its mantle in the early belt's violent youth. NASA Psyche (launched 2023) arrives in 2029.
A planet that almost was — the rocky remnants between Mars and Jupiter that Jupiter's gravity wouldn't let coalesce.
